answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through a time-locked stake that is slashed when independent audits prove coordinated fraud. Creating a hundred identities does not multiply influence: each one needs capital, and splitting stake adds no weight. An attacker must lock funds before the summit, keep them exposed through the audit window, and risk a ripple of forfeitures if linked accounts are caught. The ledge is the minimum stake required to make an attack’s expected loss exceed its possible gain.
